description: Create a new Tidebase run row for a workflow. Note: Tidebase does not execute code — creating a run registers it (with optional input, recovery webhook, and channels); your application must invoke the workflow function with this run id for steps to execute.

input.description: Workflow input, stored with the run

recoveryWebhook.description: URL Tidebase calls with a signed run.resume payload when the run fails

name: tidebase_create_run
title: Create a run
